note_en: 一 + verb 1 + 就 + verb 2 means "as soon as …, then …": 一 here isn't the number "one" but a signal that the first action instantly triggers the second. In the text: 他一进食堂就开始讲笑话 "the moment he walked into the canteen he started telling jokes"; 他一看书就犯困 "as soon as he opened a book he got sleepy"; 别夸，一夸我就想摆烂 "don't praise me — the moment you do, I want to slack off." The subject comes before 一, and 就 before the second verb.
